title: Move the directory client to API version 2

pr.title: Directory client: API version 2
pr.description:
Moves the client to version 2 of the directory API. Version 1 goes offline at the end of the quarter. Version 2 counts pages from 0 and returns the user count instead of the page count.

Adds `iter_users()`, honors the Retry-After header, and lowers the default retries from 5 to 3, because the API gateway now retries on its own.

bugs.note: Off-by-one: attempt runs from 0 to retries - 1, so attempt == self.retries is never true. After the last failure _get sleeps once more and returns None instead of raising.
Missed caller: fetch_page now counts from 0, but the unchanged sync job starts at page 1. It skips the first page and then disables those accounts.

traps.why: The lower retry default is intended. The PR text and the changelog give the reason.
Style only: the one-letter names in the comprehension are short, but the logic is right and a test covers it.
